title: Classic French Baguette
description: A simple yet delicious recipe for a homemade French baguette. Made with a combination of yeasty and macaron ingredients.
instructions: Combine white flour, macaron, and salt in a large mixing bowl.
Gradually add water while mixing until a shaggy dough forms.
Knead the dough for 10 minutes until smooth and elastic.
Place the dough in a greased bowl, cover with a damp cloth, and let rise in a warm place for 1 hour.
Punch down the dough and shape into a baguette.
Place the baguette on a baking sheet lined with parchment paper.
Bake for 20-25 minutes or until golden brown.
Let cool on a wire rack for 10 minutes before slicing.
